outcome_classes_per_case.NO_SAFE_PLAN: the planner refuses the plan at plan time because the FULL result cannot be delivered (result-policy-v1 too_large). Counted separately; NOT an engine choice and NOT unsafe.
outcome_classes_per_case.UNAVOIDABLE_UNCERTAIN: the planner chose an engine at timeout risk, attached an uncertainty note, and no other engine was execution-feasible and delivery-allowed. Counted separately; NOT 'avoidable unsafe'.
outcome_classes_per_case.AVOIDABLE_UNSAFE: the chosen engine timed out at 60 s (censored) while the other engine completed AND was feasible/liftable under policy (not blocked by delivery or another non-overridable reason); or the chosen engine was rated timeout_risk without an uncertainty note while a non-risk deliverable engine existed.
outcome_classes_per_case.RESULT_CAP_VIOLATION: a planned (non-refused) case whose delivered/actual rows exceed the cap, or a refused case whose result policy verdict was not too_large.

if_gate_missed: do not ship 0.10; keep 0.20; report that the risk model still needs improvement
final_decision_options: C. RESULT POLICY FIXED BUT RISK MODEL STILL INSUFFICIENT
replay_parity: any counterfactual replay must equal the real planner on every decidable case before use; final numbers are the real planner's recorded decisions
